question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Rajan’s caused __extremely painful__ headaches.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"extreme"** means reaching a high or the highest degree; very great. (अत्यधिक)

 
 
• **Example: **The **extreme **weather conditions made it difficult to travel.
 
 
 
• **"Excruciating" **refers to something that causes intense physical or mental pain; extremely painful. (अत्यंत पीड़ादायक)
 
 
• **Example: **The **excruciating **pain in his leg made it impossible for him to walk.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the correct word to describe extremely painful headaches is **'excruciating'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Horrible **(भयानक): Causing or likely to cause horror; shocking.

 
 
• **Example:** The movie was so** horrible **that I couldn't sleep for days.
 
 
 
• **Extreme **(अत्यधिक): Reaching a high or the highest degree; very great.
 
 
• **Example: **The** extreme **weather conditions made it difficult to travel.
 
 
 
• **Devastating** (विनाशकारी): Highly destructive or damaging.
 
 
• **Example:** The earthquake had a** devastating** effect on the small town.
